All.name: Reinforced Cloth
All.traits: Can still add half your DEX to spellshaping checks if you aren't proficient
All.description: Commonly used by adventurers unused to heavier armor.

All.name: Hide Armor
All.description: Tough leather armor made from the hides of large animals. Popular among rangers and hunters.

All.name: Leather Lamellar
All.description: Overlapping leather plates provide good all-round protection, without limiting mana recovery

All.name: Chain Mail
All.resistances: (6) Slashing, (6) Piercing, (3) Bludgeoning, (2) Cold, (2) Fire, (2) Acid, (1) Thunder
All.description: Interlocking metal rings provide good all-round protection, but are less effective against heavy blows and spells.

All.name: Splint Mail
All.resistances: (7) Slashing, (7) Piercing, (4) Bludgeoning, (3) Cold, (3) Fire, (3) Acid, (2) Thunder
All.description: Metal plates riveted to leather, designed to deflect spells and blows.

All.name: Half Plate
All.resistances: (8) Slashing, (8) Piercing, (4) Bludgeoning, (2) Cold, (2) Fire, (2) Acid, (1) Thunder
All.description: A hybrid of plate and leather, favored by dedicated battle-mages. Unlike the protection of full platemail, it has more weak points to be exploited by clever enemies.

All.name: Plate Mail
All.resistances: (10) Slashing, (10) Piercing, (5) Bludgeoning, (3) Cold, (3) Fire, (2) Acid, (2) Thunder
All.description: Full plate provides the greatest protection and has fewer weak spots to target. Being encased in metal is dampens mana recovery though, making it rarely used by mages, but favored by some knight orders.
